
```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(tibble)
library(hms)

scrapeData <- function(raceID, setID, maxPages = 10){
  all_pages <- list()
  
  for (pageNum in 1:maxPages) {
    url <- paste0("https://www.trisignup.com/Race/Results/", raceID, 
                  "?resultSetId=", setID, "&perpage=5000&page=", pageNum, "&format=json")
    
    raw_data <- fromJSON(url)
    
    df <- raw_data$resultSet$results |> 
      map_dfr(as_tibble) |> 
      clean_names()
    
    if (nrow(df) == 0) break
    
    dataList <- df[[1]]
    rowsPerPage <- nrow(df) / 27
    numVariables <- length(dataList) / rowsPerPage
    
    result_df <- matrix(dataList, nrow = rowsPerPage, byrow = FALSE) |>
      as_tibble(.name_repair = "minimal")
    
    colnames(result_df) <- c("Place", "Name", "College", "State", "Bib", "Gender", "ChipTime", "SwimRank", "SwimTime", 
                             "SwimPace", "T1Time", "BikeRank", "BikeTime", "BikePace", "T2Time", "RunRank", "RunTime",
                             "RunPace", "City", "Country", "21", "22", "Age", "24", "PlaceAgeCategory", "AgeCategory", "27")
    
    all_pages[[length(all_pages) + 1]] <- result_df
  }
  final_df <- bind_rows(all_pages)
  final_df <- final_df |> 
    mutate(RaceID = raceID,
           SetID = setID)
  return(final_df)
}

```

```{r}
ID_Pairs <- c(13387,579154, #Patriot Sprint 2025
              13387, 484168, #Patriot Sprint 2024
              13392, 585319, #Giant Acorn Olympic 2025
              #13392, 484197, #Giant Acorn Olympic 2024
              56021,591858, #Pleasant Landing Sprint 2025
              56021, 591868) #Pleasant Landing Olympic 2025

raceID_df <- matrix(ID_Pairs, ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE) |>
  as_tibble(.name_repair = "minimal") |>
  setNames(c("race_id", "set_id")) |> 
  mutate(raceName = c("Patriot's", "Patriot's","Giant Acorn","Pleasant's Landing", "Pleasant's Landing")) |> 
  mutate(raceDistance = c("Sprint", "Sprint","Olympic","Sprint", "Olympic")) |> 
  mutate(year = c(2025, 2024, 2025, 2025, 2025))

```

```{r}
all_results <- raceID_df |>
  mutate(
    data = map2(race_id, set_id, ~ scrapeData(.x, .y))
  ) |>
  select(data, raceName, raceDistance, year) |>
  unnest(data)
```

Filter results to per person
```{r}
filterResults <- function(results_df, name){
  filtered_df <- results_df |> 
    filter(Name == name)
  
  basicDetails <- filtered_df |> 
    summarise(
      Name = first(Name),
      College = max(College),
      State = max(State),
      City = max(City),
      Country = max(Country),
      Gender = first(Gender),
      Age = max(Age)
    )
  
  sprintPRResults <- filtered_df |> 
    filter(raceDistance == "Sprint") |> 
    summarise(
      Name = first(Name),
      PR_Time_Sprint = min(ChipTime),
      PR_Swim_Time_Sprint = min(SwimTime),
      PR_Swim_Pace_Sprint = min(SwimPace),
      PR_Bike_Time_Sprint = min(BikeTime),
      PR_Bike_Pace_Sprint = min(BikePace),
      PR_Run_Time_Sprint = min(RunTime),
      PR_Run_Pace_Sprint = min(RunPace)
    )
  
  olympicPRResults <- filtered_df |> 
    filter(raceDistance == "Olympic") |> 
    summarise(
      Name = first(Name),
      PR_Time_Olympic = min(ChipTime),
      PR_Swim_Time_Olympic = min(SwimTime),
      PR_Swim_Pace_Olympic = min(SwimPace),
      PR_Bike_Time_Olympic = min(BikeTime),
      PR_Bike_Pace_Olympic = min(BikePace),
      PR_Run_Time_Olympic = min(RunTime),
      PR_Run_Pace_Olympic = min(RunPace)
    )
  
  transitionPRResults <- filtered_df |> 
    summarise(
      Name = first(Name),
      PR_T1 = min(T1Time),
      PR_T2 = min(T2Time)
    )
  
  advancedDetails <- basicDetails |> 
    left_join(sprintPRResults, by = "Name") |> 
    left_join(olympicPRResults, by = "Name") |> 
    left_join(transitionPRResults, by = "Name")
  
  advancedDetails
}

```

```{r}
uniqueNames <- unique(all_results$Name)
all_df <- map_dfr(uniqueNames, ~ filterResults(all_results, .x))
athleteInformation_df <- all_df |> 
  select(Name, College, State, City, Country, Gender, Age)

collegeNameCorrections <- c(
  "Virginia Tech Triathlon" = "Virginia Tech",
  "Maryland Triathlon" = "University of Maryland",
  "NC State" = "NC State University",
  "U of Virginia" = "University of Virginia",
  "James Madison" = "James Madison University"
)

fixNames <- function(df, column, lookup){
  old_values <- df[[column]]
  needs_fix <- old_values %in% names(lookup)
  df[[column]] <- ifelse(
    needs_fix,
    lookup[old_values],
    old_values
  )
  return(df)
}

athleteInformation_df <- fixNames(athleteInformation_df, "College", collegeNameCorrections)

pr_df <- all_df |> 
  select(-College, -State, -City, -Country, -Gender, -Age)

#Convert to seconds
to_seconds <- function(x) {
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\\.[0-9]+", "")
  parsed <- parse_hms(
    case_when(
      str_detect(x, "^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}$") ~ paste0("00:", x),
      TRUE ~ x
    )
  )
  as.integer(parsed)  # seconds
}

pr_time_cols <- c(
  "PR_Time_Sprint","PR_Swim_Time_Sprint","PR_Swim_Pace_Sprint",
  "PR_Bike_Time_Sprint","PR_Run_Time_Sprint","PR_Run_Pace_Sprint",
  "PR_Time_Olympic","PR_Swim_Time_Olympic","PR_Swim_Pace_Olympic",
  "PR_Bike_Time_Olympic","PR_Run_Time_Olympic","PR_Run_Pace_Olympic",
  "PR_T1","PR_T2"
)

results_time_columns <- c(
  "ChipTime", "SwimTime", "SwimPace", "T1Time", "BikeTime",
  "T2Time", "RunTime", "RunPace"
)

pr_df <- pr_df |>
  mutate(across(all_of(pr_time_cols), to_seconds))

all_results <- all_results |>
  mutate(across(all_of(results_time_columns), to_seconds))
```
